subject: A historical memory of the OLD CAPITAL'S underground sacred spring just after a tiny sapling was planted, three hundred years before. View from water level beside the spring: a fragile green sapling on a small stone island is the focal point, while the first thick root splits the surrounding white carved pavement and dark floodwater begins spilling down the ceremonial steps behind it. One massive fallen carved column creates a strong diagonal. Nobody in frame, no priest, no king, no throne, no current palace. This is the beginning of the catastrophe: small innocent growing life versus the city it will drown. The reference supplies the ancient architecture and the later root system only; do NOT copy its large throne or old man. Cool cyan underground light, restrained gold reflections, no visible outdoor sky.
